description: Create a printed letter order (8.5x11, mailed in a #10 envelope) and get a payment link. Either write it (content.body, up to ~3 pages, optional photo) or mail the user's own PDF (content.pdf_url, a public https link, up to 6 pages). Set certified to "certified" for USPS Certified Mail with tracking and proof of delivery, or "certified_return_receipt" to add the recipient's signature; use these when the user needs proof (tax notice replies, lease notices, disputes, demand letters). Or set express for USPS Priority Mail (not with certified). Prices: get_pricing. Mails only after the user pays.

certified.description: USPS Certified Mail. "certified": tracking number and proof of mailing and delivery. "certified_return_receipt": adds the recipient's signature as proof of delivery, which landlords, courts and agencies often require. "none": regular First-Class. Prices: get_pricing.

content.description: The letter: body text (optionally with a photo) or your own PDF

body.description: Full letter text. Plain text; blank lines separate paragraphs. Use this OR pdf_url.

color.description: PDF letters only: print in color (costs a little more; see get_pricing). Text letters print in color automatically when they include image_url.

font.description: Typeface for the letter body (text letters)

image_url.description: Text letters only: optional photo printed at the top (https JPG or PNG). A letter with a photo prints in color, for a small surcharge (see get_pricing).

pdf_pages.description: Set by Sendpaper: page count of the PDF

pdf_url.description: Mail your own document instead of body text: a public https link to a PDF (up to 6 pages). Pages are fitted to 8.5×11 and a blank address page is added in front.

customer_email.description: Where to send the receipt and status updates

express.description: Send by express (USPS Priority Mail, usually 2–3 days, with tracking) for an extra charge; see get_pricing. Not available with certified.

from.description: Return address; printed on the mail piece

company.description: Company name, printed under the person's name

state.description: Two-letter US state code, e.g. NY

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string; retrying with the same key returns the original order instead of creating a duplicate

recipients.description: Send the same piece to several people: 2-25 US addresses, used INSTEAD of to. Each gets their own order and tracking; one payment covers all.

company.description: Company name, printed under the person's name

state.description: Two-letter US state code, e.g. NY

to.description: Recipient's US mailing address (or use recipients for several people)

company.description: Company name, printed under the person's name

state.description: Two-letter US state code, e.g. NY

name: create_letter

batch.description: Present when the order was created with recipients: the whole group. The top-level fields describe the first recipient's order; use batch.price and batch.checkout_url for the total and payment.

checkout_url.description: One payment link for every unpaid order in the group
Where the user pays; null once paid or cancelled

discount.description: First-order discount, already taken off price; null when none applies

orders.description: Every order in the group, when created with recipients

preview_image_url.description: PNG picture of the piece (postcard front and back, or the letter's first page) to show the user

product.description: Product id, e.g. postcard_4x6 or letter_certified

status.description: awaiting_payment, paid, printing, mailed, cancelled or refunded

status_detail.description: Plain-English status to show the user

tracking.description: USPS tracking, for Certified Mail once printed

title: Create a letter
